shots.prompt: Close-up, a young Vietnamese woman speaks softly to someone off frame on her left, slight head turn, natural blinking, warm evening light, handheld camera.
Medium shot, an old fisherman hauls a wet net onto the boat with both hands, water drips, the boat rocks, camera tracks slowly left.
Wide establishing shot of a Mekong river village at dawn, mist on the water, a small boat glides from right to left, slow push in.
